### [Bounce Back](https://bk-advisors.github.io/bounce-back/)

Sixteen chapters on adaptability, drawn from the careers of basketball's most
durable players and read across into entrepreneurship and decision-making. What
separates people who recover from a setback from people who are defined by it.

### [Modern House Building in Africa 101](https://bk-advisors.github.io/house-build-book/)

A first-time builder's guide to putting up a house in East Africa: budgeting,
land, contractors, materials, and the mistakes that cost the most. Written after
building my own, when I found almost no practical guidance aimed at this market.

[Read it →](https://bk-advisors.github.io/house-build-book/)
